target.statement: Maximum likelihood estimate of the concentration parameter κ̂ = 54.167 for the cuWN (double-contaminated wrapped normal) model fitted to the Col de la Roa wind dataset (Table 6)
target.dataset: Col de la Roa wind dataset (available in R 'circular' package)

compute.basis: No code is released, so the EM algorithm (with nested optim() over μ, κ, η and hierarchical AIC-based initialization) must be re-implemented from the paper's equations; the data are small and CPU-only, but debugging the EM to match the reported estimates is the main cost.

blockers: No code or supplementary material linked in the paper
EM/optimization must be re-implemented from equations; exact reproduction of estimates depends on initialization and optimizer settings not fully specified
title: Modelling and detecting mild and gross anomalies in circular data via double-contaminated models
